summary: Six exact-structure SIGMA=0.20 eV VASP static force-label jobs were submitted as LSF jobs 9738672-9738677 after returned dual-model review, fresh diagnostic-static preflights, geometry checks, POTCAR verification, and hash-bound SUBMIT_DIAGNOSTIC_VASP execution gates. Four were RUN and two PEND at the submission checkpoint.

payload.objective: Wait for VASP jobs 9738672-9738677 to finish, then collect scheduler evidence, verify normal/electronic completion and complete energy, force, and magnetic outputs, and compare exact-structure MatRIS-VASP and AQCat25-VASP errors before any fine-tuning decision.
current_evidence: The separate user authorization covers only the six exact-structure diagnostic-static VASP force labels pre_04, fail_04, pre_05, fail_05, pre_06, and fail_06.
All six inputs use GGA=PE, ENCUT=400 eV, ISPIN=2, ISMEAR=1, SIGMA=0.20 eV, Gamma 5x5x1, NSW=0, IBRION=-1, ISYM=0, LDIPOL=false, LORBIT=11, NPAR=4, fixed bottom-18 atoms, and 32 ranks.
The remote Fe/C/O/H POTCAR SHA-256 matched e3bc41a37d795bfcf1b1dc9a2a9ddfb5ef86aa5dc9aa0ac5a3583471a0982f85 before submission.
Each directory passed a fresh diagnostic_static preflight and a hash-bound execution gate allowing only SUBMIT_DIAGNOSTIC_VASP.
At the checkpoint, 9738672-9738675 were RUN with OUTCAR files created but no TOTEN yet; 9738676-9738677 were PEND.
No model fine-tuning, checkpoint promotion, ML-NEB rerun, micro-NEB, Dimer, automatic retry, or final-energy promotion was submitted or authorized.
payload.one_executable_step: Monitor jobs 9738672-9738677; after all are terminal, collect exact outputs and run the VASP-label quality and dual-model error assessment without automatically training a model.
payload.submission_boundary: The six VASP labels are force-label-only and cannot enter the final barrier energy chain. Any failed job retry and any MatRIS fine-tuning or path rerun require a new reviewed action and separate authorization.
done_when: All six LSF jobs have terminal scheduler evidence and their OUTCAR/OSZICAR outputs are collected.
Every accepted label passes normal termination, electronic convergence, exact structure/order, complete 50-atom forces, total and atom-resolved magnetic evidence, and the active DFT fingerprint.
MatRIS-VASP and AQCat25-VASP errors are assessed on the same six structures and the MatRIS trigger verdict is recorded.
